messages:
incident-bot: ALERT severity=sev2 -> customer-specific degradation detected: tenant 'NovaTech' on dedicated pool dp-novatech-7. Model rwd-gptx-3@vq-8-beta showing quality regression. QA-hook: embedding-sim drop >15%, rouge-L delta -10%. ~85 req/min impacted. Paging SRE + ML infra.
Maya (SRE): I'm on pager. tagging ML infra. initial check: dp-novatech-7 is healthy, networking fine, traffic still pinned. Looks like a model-only issue.
Ethan (ML Infra): I see it. pulling the deploy history for rwd-gptx-3 on that pool. Last quant-profile change: vq-8-beta deployed at 4290000900 by deploy-bot. Running a quick_eval with customer sample set.
Lina (CSM): sending 4 examples from NovaTech that started failing around 09:22 PT. symptoms: hallucinated entity names and truncated summaries.
Ethan (ML Infra): thanks. local eval: vq-8-beta vs vq-4-stable
- rouge-L: baseline 0.72 -> 0.62
- embedding cosine: 0.89 -> 0.74
That's consistent with customer reports. suspect vq-8-beta is aggressive quant leading to precision loss on this workload.
Maya (SRE): we should avoid global rollback. This is a dedicated pool - can we target this tenant only? Need plan and ETA.
Ethan (ML Infra): yes, we can patch the pool config. Options:
1) per-pool quant rollback to vq-4-stable (fast, minimal infra churn)
2) pin pool to prior artifact rwd-gptx-3@2026-02-18 (full precision) — longer but safest
3) route traffic to a warmed fallback pool (if capacity exists)
I'm leaning to option 1 for immediate mitigation + follow-up with 2 if issues persist.
Maya (SRE): agree. run a canary within the pool first? maybe flip 30% initially then full? But time is sensitive.
Ethan (ML Infra): given severity, hit full per-pool rollback but enable live canary telemetry for first 20 minutes. Command to run:
```
redwoodctl pool update dp-novatech-7 --set quant_profile=vq-4-stable --target 100 --reason "mitigate customer regression"
```
or API:
POST /internal/pools/dp-novatech-7/actions
{ "op": "set_quant", "profile": "vq-4-stable", "force": true }

I'll execute now.
Ethan (ML Infra): executing... deploy-bot: scheduled rollout rollout-4290001180 by ethan
deploy-bot: started rollout rollout-4290001180 -> dp-novatech-7
Maya (SRE): watching health checks. redis cache warming noted. no spike in errors so far. rolling across 6 replicas.
oncall-rot: I will pick up monitoring and customer updates after handoff. Maya, can you handoff after rollout completes?
Maya (SRE): handing off in 10m once rollout completes. current plan: if post-rollout rouge-L delta <= -2% vs baseline, mark mitigated. else, escalate to full artifact pin.
Ethan (ML Infra): rollout logs:
```
> rollout-4290001180: applying vq-4-stable
> replica 1/6 ok
> replica 2/6 ok
> replica 3/6 ok
> replica 4/6 ok
> replica 5/6 ok
> replica 6/6 ok
> rollout complete
```
deploy-bot: rollout-4290001180 complete
Maya (SRE): post-deploy checks: quick_eval shows rouge-L delta -0.8% and embedding cos 0.88 (near baseline). QA-hook alerts clearing.
oncall-rot: running customer samples against live endpoint: outputs look correct now. notifying Lina to tell NovaTech.
Lina (CSM): messaging NovaTech: "We rolled back a quantization change on your dedicated pool dp-novatech-7 at 09:27 PT which should restore output quality. Please check the latest responses and flag any residual issues. We're continuing to monitor for 30 minutes. Apologies for the disruption." Will attach this thread.
Maya (SRE): creating incident ticket INC-4290 for RCA. provisional cause: insufficient per-tenant regression testing for vq-8-beta; missing dedicated-pool canary in release pipeline. Action items: add dedicated-pool evalsets to pre-release CI, require targeted canary per pool with automatic rollback triggers (rouge-L delta >5% or embedding drop >10%).
Ethan (ML Infra): adding to release engineering backlog: gate quant-profile promotion behind per-pool canary. Also add a safety limiter on vq-8-beta to exclude pools with specialized vocab/long-tail corpora until validated.
oncall-rot: marking incident mitigated for now. I'll watch metrics for 30m and escalate if regression reappears. Creating follow-up note in Jira: INC-4290.
deploy-bot: audit entry created: rollout-4290001180 by ethan, audit_id audit-9052
Lina (CSM): NovaTech replied: "Thanks — quality looks good now. Please confirm you will follow up with root cause and steps to prevent recurrence." I'll schedule a 1:1 with them after our RCA. thanks team.
Maya (SRE): thanks all. handoff complete to oncall-rot. keep channel posted if anything changes.
